**FINAL SQL:**

```sql
WITH winner_counts AS (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
),
max_winner AS (
    SELECT winner_id
    FROM winner_counts
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
latest_ranking AS (
    SELECT r.player_id, r.ranking_points
    FROM rankings r
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_id, MAX(ranking_date) AS max_date
        FROM rankings
        GROUP BY player_id
    ) mr ON r.player_id = mr.player_id AND r.ranking_date = mr.max_date
)
SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name, lr.ranking_points
FROM players p
JOIN max_winner mw ON p.player_id = mw.winner_id
JOIN latest_ranking lr ON lr.player_id = mw.winner_id;
```
